description: Save a DRAFT of postcards, from a single card to one person (e.g. "send a thank-you postcard to my aunt") to a whole registry or guest list, and return a link where the sender adds their return address, reviews every card, and pays on shipnote.co. This tool never mails a card and never charges anyone. Each recipient is one card (one per household for a list): the name as it appears on the card, the full US mailing address as "Street, City, ST ZIP" (empty if unknown), and the gift as a short noun phrase without the store name (e.g. "stand mixer", not "KitchenAid stand mixer from Target"). senderName is the name the sender signs cards with; without it, the default message stays unsigned until the sender fills it in on shipnote.co. Up to 500 recipients per draft. Each call makes a new draft with a new link. This tool can't take a picture. A photo card (the sender's own picture as the whole front) is saved with design image-only, and the sender adds the photo on shipnote.co after opening the link; a photo inside a design uses a design marked (1 photo). list_card_designs also shows designs that need no photo.

design.description: A design id from list_card_designs for that occasion.

message.description: The card message, with [RECIPIENT] and [GIFT_NAME] as placeholders ShipNote fills in for each card. Defaults to the occasion's standard message.

senderName.description: How the sender signs, e.g. "Sam & Alex". Replaces [YOUR NAME] and becomes the return-address name.

name: create_draft
title: Save cards as a draft
